verses.original: וַיְצַ֞ו אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ בֵּיתוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ מַלֵּ֞א אֶת־ אַמְתְּחֹ֤ת הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֹ֔כֶל כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יוּכְל֖וּן שְׂאֵ֑ת וְשִׂ֥ים כֶּֽסֶף־ אִ֖ישׁ בְּפִ֥י אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ’eṯ- ’ă·šer ‘al- bê·ṯōw lê·mōr mal·lê ’eṯ- ’am·tə·ḥōṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ō·ḵel ka·’ă·šer yū·ḵə·lūn śə·’êṯ wə·śîm ke·sep̄- ’îš bə·p̄î ’am·taḥ·tōw
verses.literal: Then Joseph instructed his steward . . . . . . . . . Fill the men’s sacks with as much food as they can carry and put each one’s silver in the mouth of his sack
verses.literalPt: E DEU ordem ao que estava sobre a sua casa, dizendo: Enche de mantimento os sacos destes homens, quanto puderem levar, e põe o dinheiro de cada um na boca do seu saco.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ גְּבִיעִ֞י גְּבִ֣יעַ הַכֶּ֗סֶף תָּשִׂים֙ בְּפִי֙ אַמְתַּ֣חַת הַקָּטֹ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף שִׁבְר֑וֹ וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כִּדְבַ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- gə·ḇî·‘î gə·ḇî·a‘ hak·ke·sep̄ tā·śîm bə·p̄î ’am·ta·ḥaṯ haq·qā·ṭōn wə·’êṯ ke·sep̄ šiḇ·rōw way·ya·‘aś kiḏ·ḇar yō·w·sêp̄ ’ă·šer dib·bêr
verses.literal: Put my cup the silver one in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack along with the silver for his grain So the steward did . . . as Joseph had instructed
verses.literalPt: E o meu copo, o copo de prata, porás na boca do saco do mais novo, com o dinheiro do seu trigo. E fez conforme a palavra que José tinha dito.

verses.original: הַבֹּ֖קֶר א֑וֹר וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים שֻׁלְּח֔וּ הֵ֖מָּה וַחֲמֹרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bō·qer ’ō·wr wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm šul·lə·ḥū hêm·māh wa·ḥă·mō·rê·hem
verses.literal: At daybreak . . . the men were sent on their way . . . with their donkeys
verses.literalPt: Vinda a luz da manhã, despediram-se estes homens, eles com os seus jumentos.

verses.original: הֵ֠ם יָֽצְא֣וּ אֶת־ הָעִיר֮ לֹ֣א הִרְחִיקוּ֒ וְיוֹסֵ֤ף אָמַר֙ לַֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ בֵּית֔וֹ ק֥וּם רְדֹ֖ף אַחֲרֵ֣י הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְהִשַּׂגְתָּם֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לָ֛מָּה שִׁלַּמְתֶּ֥ם רָעָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hêm yā·ṣə·’ū ’eṯ- hā·‘îr lō hir·ḥî·qū wə·yō·w·sêp̄ ’ā·mar la·’ă·šer ‘al- bê·ṯōw qūm rə·ḏōp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê hā·’ă·nā·šîm wə·hiś·śaḡ·tām wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem lām·māh šil·lam·tem rā·‘āh ta·ḥaṯ ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: They had not gone far from the city when Joseph told his steward . . . . . . Pursue . . . the men at once and when you overtake them ask . . . Why have you repaid good with evil
verses.literalPt: Saindo eles da cidade, e não se havendo ainda distanciado, disse José ao que estava sobre a sua casa: Levanta-te, e persegue aqueles homens; e, alcançando-os, lhes dirás: Por que pagastes mal por bem?

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא זֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁתֶּ֤ה אֲדֹנִי֙ בּ֔וֹ וְה֕וּא נַחֵ֥שׁ יְנַחֵ֖שׁ בּ֑וֹ הֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w zeh ’ă·šer yiš·teh ’ă·ḏō·nî bōw wə·hū na·ḥêš yə·na·ḥêš bōw hă·rê·‘ō·ṯem ’ă·šer ‘ă·śî·ṯem
verses.literal: Is this not the cup . . . my master drinks from and uses for divination . . . What you have done is wicked
verses.literalPt: Não é este o copo em que bebe meu senhor e pelo qual bem adivinha? Procedestes mal no que fizestes.

verses.original: וַֽיַּשִּׂגֵ֑ם וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaś·śi·ḡêm way·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: When the steward overtook them he relayed these words to them
verses.literalPt: E alcançou-os, e falou-lhes as mesmas palavras.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו לָ֚מָּה יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲדֹנִ֔י כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה חָלִ֙ילָה֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ מֵעֲשׂ֖וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw lām·māh yə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·ḏō·nî kad·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ḥā·lî·lāh la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā mê·‘ă·śō·wṯ kad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Why does my lord say these things they asked . . . Your servants could not possibly do such a thing
verses.literalPt: E eles disseram-lhe: Por que diz meu senhor tais palavras? Longe estejam teus servos de fazerem semelhante coisa.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן כֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָצָ֙אנוּ֙ בְּפִ֣י אַמְתְּחֹתֵ֔ינוּ הֱשִׁיבֹ֥נוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְאֵ֗יךְ נִגְנֹב֙ מִבֵּ֣ית אֲדֹנֶ֔יךָ כֶּ֖סֶף א֥וֹ זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hên ke·sep̄ ’ă·šer mā·ṣā·nū bə·p̄î ’am·tə·ḥō·ṯê·nū hĕ·šî·ḇō·nū ’ê·le·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an wə·’êḵ niḡ·nōḇ mib·bêṯ ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā ke·sep̄ ’ōw zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: We even brought back to you from the land of Canaan the silver we found in the mouths of our sacks Why would we steal silver or gold from your master’s house
verses.literalPt: Eis que o dinheiro, que temos achado nas bocas dos nossos sacos, te tornamos a trazer desde a terra de Canaã; como, pois, furtaríamos da casa do teu senhor prata ou ouro?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֥א אִתּ֛וֹ מֵעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וָמֵ֑ת וְגַם־ אֲנַ֕חְנוּ נִֽהְיֶ֥ה לַֽאדֹנִ֖י לַעֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer yim·mā·ṣê ’it·tōw mê·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā wā·mêṯ wə·ḡam- ’ă·naḥ·nū nih·yeh la·ḏō·nî la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm
verses.literal: If any of your servants is found to have it he must die and the rest . . . will become slaves of my lord
verses.literalPt: Aquele, com quem de teus servos for achado, morra; e ainda nós seremos escravos do meu senhor.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם־ עַתָּ֥ה כְדִבְרֵיכֶ֖ם כֶּן־ ה֑וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֤א אִתּוֹ֙ יִהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י עָ֔בֶד וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְי֥וּ נְקִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer gam- ‘at·tāh ḵə·ḏiḇ·rê·ḵem ken- hū ’ă·šer yim·mā·ṣê ’it·tōw yih·yeh- lî ‘ā·ḇeḏ wə·’at·tem tih·yū nə·qî·yim
verses.literal: As you say replied the steward . . . But only the one who is found with the cup will be my slave and the rest of you shall be free of blame
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Ora seja também assim conforme as vossas palavras; aquele com quem se achar será meu escravo, porém vós sereis desculpados.

verses.original: וַֽיְמַהֲר֗וּ וַיּוֹרִ֛דוּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ אַמְתַּחְתּ֖וֹ אָ֑רְצָה וַֽיִּפְתְּח֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ma·hă·rū way·yō·w·ri·ḏū ’îš ’eṯ- ’am·taḥ·tōw ’ā·rə·ṣāh way·yip̄·tə·ḥū ’îš ’am·taḥ·tōw
verses.literal: So each one quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened . . . it
verses.literalPt: E eles apressaram-se e cada um pôs em terra o seu saco, e cada um abriu o seu saco.

verses.original: וַיְחַפֵּ֕שׂ בַּגָּד֣וֹל הֵחֵ֔ל וּבַקָּטֹ֖ן כִּלָּ֑ה וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ הַגָּבִ֔יעַ בְּאַמְתַּ֖חַת בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥap·pêś bag·gā·ḏō·wl hê·ḥêl ū·ḇaq·qā·ṭōn kil·lāh way·yim·mā·ṣê hag·gā·ḇî·a‘ bə·’am·ta·ḥaṯ bin·yā·min
verses.literal: The steward searched beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack
verses.literalPt: E buscou, começando do maior, e acabando no mais novo; e achou-se o copo no saco de Benjamim.

verses.original: וַֽיִּקְרְע֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲמֹס֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־ חֲמֹר֔וֹ וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ הָעִֽירָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·‘ū śim·lō·ṯām way·ya·‘ă·mōs ’îš ‘al- ḥă·mō·rōw way·yā·šu·ḇū hā·‘î·rāh
verses.literal: Then they all tore their clothes - loaded their donkeys and returned to the city
verses.literalPt: Então rasgaram as suas vestes, e carregou cada um o seu jumento, e tornaram à cidade.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יְהוּדָ֤ה וְאֶחָיו֙ בֵּ֣יתָה יוֹסֵ֔ף וְה֖וּא עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּפְּל֥וּ לְפָנָ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’e·ḥāw bê·ṯāh yō·w·sêp̄ wə·hū ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū šām way·yip·pə·lū lə·p̄ā·nāw ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: When Judah and his brothers arrived at Joseph’s house he was still there and they fell to the ground before him
verses.literalPt: E veio Judá com os seus irmãos à casa de José, porque ele ainda estava ali; e prostraram-se diante dele em terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף מָֽה־ הַמַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם הֲל֣וֹא יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם כִּֽי־ נַחֵ֧שׁ יְנַחֵ֛שׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּמֹֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem yō·w·sêp̄ māh- ham·ma·‘ă·śeh haz·zeh ’ă·šer ‘ă·śî·ṯem hă·lō·w yə·ḏa‘·tem kî- na·ḥêš yə·na·ḥêš ’îš ’ă·šer kā·mō·nî
verses.literal: What is this deed you have done Joseph declared Do you not know that a man like me can surely divine the truth . . .
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes José: Que é isto que fizestes? Não sabeis vós que um homem como eu pode, muito bem, adivinhar?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֗ה מַה־ נֹּאמַר֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י מַה־ נְּדַבֵּ֖ר וּמַה־ נִּצְטַדָּ֑ק הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים מָצָא֙ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ הִנֶּנּ֤וּ עֲבָדִים֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י גַּם־ אֲנַ֕חְנוּ גַּ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִמְצָ֥א הַגָּבִ֖יעַ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hū·ḏāh mah- nō·mar la·ḏō·nî mah- nə·ḏab·bêr ū·mah- niṣ·ṭad·dāq hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm mā·ṣā ’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā hin·nen·nū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm la·ḏō·nî gam- ’ă·naḥ·nū gam ’ă·šer- nim·ṣā hag·gā·ḇî·a‘ bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: What can we say to my lord Judah replied How can we plead How can we justify ourselves God has exposed the iniquity of your servants We are now my lord’s slaves both we and the one who was found with the cup
verses.literalPt: Então disse Judá: Que diremos a meu senhor? Que falaremos? E como nos justificaremos? Achou Deus a iniqüidade de teus servos; eis que somos escravos de meu senhor, tanto nós como aquele em cuja mão foi achado o copo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חָלִ֣ילָה לִּ֔י מֵעֲשׂ֖וֹת זֹ֑את הָאִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א הַגָּבִ֜יעַ בְּיָד֗וֹ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י עָ֔בֶד וְאַתֶּ֕ם עֲל֥וּ לְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־ אֲבִיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥā·lî·lāh lî mê·‘ă·śō·wṯ zōṯ hā·’îš ’ă·šer nim·ṣā hag·gā·ḇî·a‘ bə·yā·ḏōw hū yih·yeh- lî ‘ā·ḇeḏ wə·’at·tem ‘ă·lū lə·šā·lō·wm ’el- ’ă·ḇî·ḵem
verses.literal: But Joseph replied Far be it from me to do this The man who was found with . . . the cup will be my slave The rest of you may return to your father in peace
verses.literalPt: Mas ele disse: Longe de mim que eu tal faça; o homem em cuja mão o copo foi achado, esse será meu servo; porém vós, subi em paz para vosso pai.

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ אֵלָ֜יו יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיֹּאמֶר֮ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִי֒ יְדַבֶּר־ נָ֨א עַבְדְּךָ֤ דָבָר֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י וְאַל־ יִ֥חַר אַפְּךָ֖ בְּעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י כָמ֖וֹךָ כְּפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš ’ê·lāw yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer bî ’ă·ḏō·nî yə·ḏab·ber- nā ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ḏā·ḇār bə·’ā·zə·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî wə·’al- yi·ḥar ’ap·pə·ḵā bə·‘aḇ·de·ḵā kî ḵā·mō·w·ḵā kə·p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: Then Judah approached Joseph and said Sir . . . please let your servant . . . . . . speak personally to my lord Do not be angry . . . with your servant for you are equal to Pharaoh himself
verses.literalPt: Então Judá se chegou a ele, e disse: Ai! senhor meu, deixa, peço-te, o teu servo dizer uma palavra aos ouvidos de meu senhor, e não se acenda a tua ira contra o teu servo; porque tu és como Faraó.

verses.original: אֲדֹנִ֣י שָׁאַ֔ל אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר הֲיֵשׁ־ לָכֶ֥ם אָ֖ב אוֹ־ אָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nî šā·’al ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw lê·mōr hă·yêš- lā·ḵem ’āḇ ’ōw- ’āḥ
verses.literal: My lord asked his servants . . . Do you have . . . a father or a brother
verses.literalPt: Meu senhor perguntou a seus servos, dizendo: Tendes vós pai, ou irmão?

verses.original: וַנֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֔י יֶשׁ־ לָ֙נוּ֙ אָ֣ב זָקֵ֔ן וְיֶ֥לֶד זְקֻנִ֖ים קָטָ֑ן וְאָחִ֨יו מֵ֜ת וַיִּוָּתֵ֨ר ה֧וּא לְבַדּ֛וֹ לְאִמּ֖וֹ וְאָבִ֥יו אֲהֵבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nō·mer ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nî yeš- lā·nū ’āḇ zā·qên wə·ye·leḏ zə·qu·nîm qā·ṭān wə·’ā·ḥîw mêṯ way·yiw·wā·ṯêr hū lə·ḇad·dōw lə·’im·mōw wə·’ā·ḇîw ’ă·hê·ḇōw
verses.literal: And we answered . . . . . . We have . . . an elderly father and a younger brother the child of his old age The boy’s brother is dead He is the only one of his mother’s sons left and his father loves him
verses.literalPt: E dissemos a meu senhor: Temos um velho pai, e um filho da sua velhice, o mais novo, cujo irmão é morto; e só ele ficou de sua mãe, e seu pai o ama.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ הוֹרִדֻ֖הוּ אֵלָ֑י וְאָשִׂ֥ימָה עֵינִ֖י עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā hō·w·ri·ḏu·hū ’ê·lāy wə·’ā·śî·māh ‘ê·nî ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Then you told . . . your servants Bring him down to me so that I can see him for myself
verses.literalPt: Então tu disseste a teus servos: Trazei-mo a mim, e porei os meus olhos sobre ele.

verses.original: וַנֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֔י לֹא־ יוּכַ֥ל הַנַּ֖עַר לַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־ אָבִ֑יו וְעָזַ֥ב אֶת־ אָבִ֖יו וָמֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nō·mer ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nî lō- yū·ḵal han·na·‘ar la·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw wə·‘ā·zaḇ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw wā·mêṯ
verses.literal: So we said to my lord The boy cannot . . . leave his father If he were to leave his father would die
verses.literalPt: E nós dissemos a meu senhor: Aquele moço não poderá deixar a seu pai; se deixar a seu pai, este morrerá.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ אִם־ לֹ֥א יֵרֵ֛ד אֲחִיכֶ֥ם הַקָּטֹ֖ן אִתְּכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תֹסִפ֖וּן לִרְא֥וֹת פָּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’im- lō yê·rêḏ ’ă·ḥî·ḵem haq·qā·ṭōn ’it·tə·ḵem lō ṯō·si·p̄ūn lir·’ō·wṯ pā·nāy
verses.literal: But you said to your servants Unless your younger brother comes down with you you will not see my face again
verses.literalPt: Então tu disseste a teus servos: Se vosso irmão mais novo não descer convosco, nunca mais vereis a minha face.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כִּ֣י עָלִ֔ינוּ אֶֽל־ עַבְדְּךָ֖ אָבִ֑י וַנַּ֨גֶּד־ ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî ‘ā·lî·nū ’el- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’ā·ḇî wan·nag·geḏ- lōw ’êṯ diḇ·rê ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: Now when . . . we returned to your servant my father we relayed your words . . . to him
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, subindo nós a teu servo meu pai, e contando-lhe as palavras de meu senhor,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָבִ֑ינוּ שֻׁ֖בוּ שִׁבְרוּ־ לָ֥נוּ מְעַט־ אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ā·ḇî·nū šu·ḇū šiḇ·rū- lā·nū mə·‘aṭ- ’ō·ḵel
verses.literal: Then our father said Go back and buy us some food
verses.literalPt: Disse nosso pai: Voltai, comprai-nos um pouco de mantimento.

verses.original: וַנֹּ֕אמֶר לֹ֥א נוּכַ֖ל לָרֶ֑דֶת אִם־ יֵשׁ֩ אָחִ֨ינוּ הַקָּטֹ֤ן אִתָּ֙נוּ֙ וְיָרַ֔דְנוּ כִּי־ לֹ֣א נוּכַ֗ל לִרְאוֹת֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָאִ֔ישׁ וְאָחִ֥ינוּ הַקָּטֹ֖ן אֵינֶ֥נּוּ אִתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nō·mer lō nū·ḵal lā·re·ḏeṯ ’im- yêš ’ā·ḥî·nū haq·qā·ṭōn ’it·tā·nū wə·yā·raḏ·nū kî- lō nū·ḵal lir·’ō·wṯ pə·nê hā·’îš wə·’ā·ḥî·nū haq·qā·ṭōn ’ê·nen·nū ’it·tā·nū
verses.literal: But we answered We cannot . . . go down there unless . . . our younger brother goes . . . with us So if our younger brother is not with us we cannot . . . see . . . the man
verses.literalPt: E nós dissemos: Não poderemos descer; mas, se nosso irmão menor for conosco, desceremos; pois não poderemos ver a face do homem se este nosso irmão menor não estiver conosco.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר עַבְדְּךָ֥ אָבִ֖י אֵלֵ֑ינוּ אַתֶּ֣ם יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם כִּ֥י שְׁנַ֖יִם יָֽלְדָה־ לִּ֥י אִשְׁתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’ā·ḇî ’ê·lê·nū ’at·tem yə·ḏa‘·tem kî šə·na·yim yā·lə·ḏāh- lî ’iš·tî
verses.literal: And your servant my father said to us You know that my wife bore me two sons
verses.literalPt: Então disse-nos teu servo, meu pai: Vós sabeis que minha mulher me deu dois filhos;

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א הָֽאֶחָד֙ מֵֽאִתִּ֔י וָאֹמַ֕ר אַ֖ךְ טָרֹ֣ף טֹרָ֑ף וְלֹ֥א רְאִיתִ֖יו עַד־ הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hā·’e·ḥāḏ mê·’it·tî wā·’ō·mar ’aḵ ṭā·rōp̄ ṭō·rāp̄ wə·lō rə·’î·ṯîw ‘aḏ- hên·nāh
verses.literal: When one of them was gone . . . I said Surely he has been torn to pieces . . . And I have not seen him . . . since
verses.literalPt: E um ausentou-se de mim, e eu disse: Certamente foi despedaçado, e não o tenho visto até agora;

verses.original: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֧ם גַּם־ אֶת־ זֶ֛ה מֵעִ֥ם פָּנַ֖י וְקָרָ֣הוּ אָס֑וֹן וְהֽוֹרַדְתֶּ֧ם אֶת־ שֵׂיבָתִ֛י בְּרָעָ֖ה שְׁאֹֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·qaḥ·tem gam- ’eṯ- zeh mê·‘im pā·nay wə·qā·rā·hū ’ā·sō·wn wə·hō·w·raḏ·tem ’eṯ- śê·ḇā·ṯî bə·rā·‘āh šə·’ō·lāh
verses.literal: Now if you also take this one from me and harm comes to him you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow
verses.literalPt: Se agora também tirardes a este da minha face, e lhe acontecer algum desastre, fareis descer as minhas cãs com aflição à sepultura.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה כְּבֹאִי֙ אֶל־ עַבְדְּךָ֣ אָבִ֔י וְהַנַּ֖עַר אֵינֶ֣נּוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ קְשׁוּרָ֥ה בְנַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh kə·ḇō·’î ’el- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’ā·ḇî wə·han·na·‘ar ’ê·nen·nū ’it·tā·nū wə·nap̄·šōw qə·šū·rāh ḇə·nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: So if the boy is not with us when I return to your servant and if my father whose life is wrapped up in the boy’s life
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, indo eu a teu servo, meu pai, e o moço não indo conosco, como a sua alma está ligada com a alma dele,

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּרְאוֹת֛וֹ כִּי־ אֵ֥ין הַנַּ֖עַר וָמֵ֑ת וְהוֹרִ֨ידוּ עֲבָדֶ֜יךָ אֶת־ שֵׂיבַ֨ת עַבְדְּךָ֥ אָבִ֛ינוּ בְּיָג֖וֹן שְׁאֹֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kir·’ō·w·ṯōw kî- ’ên han·na·‘ar wā·mêṯ wə·hō·w·rî·ḏū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’eṯ- śê·ḇaṯ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’ā·ḇî·nū bə·yā·ḡō·wn šə·’ō·lāh
verses.literal: sees that the boy is not with us he will die Then your servants will have brought the gray hair of your servant our father down to Sheol in sorrow
verses.literalPt: Acontecerá que, vendo ele que o moço ali não está, morrerá; e teus servos farão descer as cãs de teu servo, nosso pai, com tristeza à sepultura.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַבְדְּךָ֙ עָרַ֣ב אֶת־ הַנַּ֔עַר מֵעִ֥ם אָבִ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־ לֹ֤א אֲבִיאֶ֙נּוּ֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְחָטָ֥אתִי לְאָבִ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ‘ā·raḇ ’eṯ- han·na·‘ar mê·‘im ’ā·ḇî lê·mōr ’im- lō ’ă·ḇî·’en·nū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lə·’ā·ḇî kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Indeed your servant guaranteed the boy’s safety to my father saying If I do not return him to you I will bear the guilt before you, my father all my life
verses.literalPt: Porque teu servo se deu por fiador por este moço para com meu pai, dizendo: Se eu o não tornar para ti, serei culpado para com meu pai por todos os dias.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה יֵֽשֶׁב־ נָ֤א עַבְדְּךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת הַנַּ֔עַר עֶ֖בֶד לַֽאדֹנִ֑י וְהַנַּ֖עַר יַ֥עַל עִם־ אֶחָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh yê·šeḇ- nā ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ han·na·‘ar ‘e·ḇeḏ la·ḏō·nî wə·han·na·‘ar ya·‘al ‘im- ’e·ḥāw
verses.literal: Now please let your servant stay here as my lord’s . . . slave in place of the boy Let him return with his brothers
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, fique teu servo em lugar deste moço por escravo de meu senhor, e que suba o moço com os seus irmãos.

verses.original: כִּי־ אֵיךְ֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֣ה אֶל־ אָבִ֔י וְהַנַּ֖עַר אֵינֶ֣נּוּ אִתִּ֑י פֶּ֚ן אֶרְאֶ֣ה בָרָ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִמְצָ֖א אֶת־ אָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’êḵ ’e·‘ĕ·leh ’el- ’ā·ḇî wə·han·na·‘ar ’ê·nen·nū ’it·tî pen ’er·’eh ḇā·rā‘ ’ă·šer yim·ṣā ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: For how can I go back to my father without . . . the boy I could not bear to see the misery that would overwhelm him
verses.literalPt: Porque, como subirei eu a meu pai, se o moço não for comigo? para que não veja eu o mal que sobrevirá a meu pai.
